string_step_plans.law: Batch 1 step plans (Diablo LP1/RP2-only strings, 2026-10-25). Engine: fighter.js _attackClipPlan step-plan branch (from #1096). A step plays its row ONLY when status is verified (button bitmask + stance + throw gates pass, plus the Job 1 limb-peak proxy except in jump context). review/unmapped steps play NO bank row - never a donor/generic row - and are flagged in _atkPlan.unmapped. T3 rows here are FALLBACK (see docs/anim/PROCEDURAL_AUDIT.md Diablo-Batch-1 entry): diablo's T3 bank is heihachi (t3_source heihachi, t3_bank moveset_heihachi.json, verified from the file on BOTH #1096 and main + the t3/ directory listing + Job 1/2/4 assignments). Bank resolution, documented not assumed: moveset/Job 2 bank heihachi <-> Job 1/Job 4/pack bank heihachi_on_jin <-> divmot13_heihachi.bin on the jin rig (the heihachi/ dir carries hit_frames + skeleton but NO rows.pack.json, the known 404 gap; the playable pack lives under heihachi_on_jin, and the two hit_frames.json files are the SAME blob a87184616...). Heihachi-bank rules, per-bank evidence (never a cross-bank blanket ban): row 35 does NOT EXIST in this bank (absent from both hit_frames and Job 1), so no row-35 rule applies; row 220 is a JUMP RK4 row here (hit_frames [39,39,88,535,0,8], Job 1 stance jump) - gate-adjudicated like any row, NOT jin's standing RP2 row, NOT king's jumping chord row, NOT bryan's button-0 row; heihachi_on_jin row 216 is a DUCK-DIP row, NOT jin row 216's jump row and NOT king row 216's dash Konvict Kick. Existing entries gained only an anim_ref field where one was missing. wh: refs are placeholders for animations not yet authored (see canon file header); made: refs are wiring labels pending the sibling animation lane clips. NOT play-verified.

t7_motbin.method: Additive wiring: this section is NEW. No existing moveset entry was modified, reordered, or deleted. Existing playable moves keep their current anim_ref; motbin internal moves are NOT joined to playable input keys by name similarity, and no .mvl display walk was performed in this batch, so no existing anim_ref was overwritten on a guess. A future input-key join must be walk-verified from the cancel tables below.
t7_motbin.anim_ref_format: t7mot:<code>:0xXXXX where XXXX is the exact anim_ref from mot.bin; bank = anim_ref & 0xC000; clip_key = anim_ref - bank
t7_motbin.cancel_note: String continuations are ONLY these cancel rows from the file. move_id >= 0x8000 is an alias reference, not a move index, and must not be resolved silently. Runtime input keys stay 1/2/3/4; input_lp is display only (1=LP1, 2=RP2, 3=LK3, 4=RK4).
t7_motbin.damage_note: damage here is the motbin hit_condition damage for the move; it is NOT MOD damage and does NOT replace any existing t7.damage in this file.
t7_motbin.clip_blocker: 0x8000-bank clip bytes: the 0x8000 MOTA block is not present in tkdata repo files; clip bytes live only in pakchunk archives / live-game memory, which this Linux VM without GPU cannot run. Those moves carry clip_status BLOCKER_MAIN_MOTA_NOT_IN_TKDATA; their key is recorded, bytes were not guessed. 0x0000/0x4000 rows carry SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_BYTES_UNRESOLVED: source identified by bank, byte offsets not resolved in this batch.
t7_motbin.editor_note: Loader/editor consumption of this section (Move List Creator) is a follow-up for the game-code lane; this PR wires the data into the file at the correct integration point without rewriting game code.

unmapped_basics.reason: Row 46 starts-airborne; no clean Heihachi LP1 row (slot-318 is a back-step RIGHT-arm punch, wrong arm for LP1).

chord_string_enders.status: UNMAPPED — left unwired. A string needs a verified sequence clip and no such row exists in-bank. No string ender was rewired to a single-hit row.

t3_verification_2026_10_24.legacy_strings_arrays_note: Legacy `strings` arrays are NOT consumed by fighter.js; left unchanged.
t3_verification_2026_10_24.runtime_effect_of_unmapped_marking: Marked entries carry no exact anim_ref/t3_row claim, so the runtime falls to donor/match/generic for those presses and the editor shows them as unmapped (not offered as swap targets) until a verified exact row lands. The former row is kept in t3_unmapped_former_row for audit trail only.
